findings.finding: `zerionEnabled` breaks the sibling feature-flag naming pattern — every other key is suffix-less (`email`, `sesEmail`, `zerionPositions`, `debugLogs`).
Two Zerion feature gates still coexist after the rename (`zerionEnabled`, `zerionPositions`) — consolidation candidate per the multi-gated-path clause.
